title: Settings
searchHint: Try notifications, shortcuts, themes or models, or clear the search to browse all settings.

general.title: General
general.description: Startup, updates and notifications. Changes apply after Save at the bottom.
general.openLastProjectDesc: Automatically restore the last opened project directory
general.autoCheckUpdateDesc: Background check of GitHub Releases after launch; shows notes and one-click install when available
general.prereleaseDesc: Also consider GitHub prerelease versions when checking for updates.
general.appVersionDesc: Check now; if an update exists, show notes and one-click install
general.alertSectionDesc: Manage sound, OS notifications, and interaction alerts that need immediate attention.
general.macNotifyHint: On macOS, allow notifications in System Settings or banners will not appear.
general.completionAlertDesc: Choose when finished or failed Agent turns notify you, what they show, and how they are delivered.
general.alertSoundDesc: Play a short beep on user alerts (combined with options below)
general.alertNotificationDesc: Use the OS notification center; it plays sound when alerts are enabled
general.alertOnExtensionUiDesc: Alert when a compatibility-layer dialog needs your answer (Agent will pause and wait)
general.alertOnRunIdleDesc: Alert when the focused session Agent goes idle
general.alertOnBackgroundRunIdleDesc: Notify when a background session finishes (off by default)
general.alertOnRunFailedDesc: Also notify when an Agent turn fails. User-cancelled turns stay silent by default.
general.alertOnlyUnfocusedDesc: Do not notify when the app is focused on the finished session
general.alertPreviewDesc: When off, show a fixed finished message instead of the AI reply
general.alertDeliveryDesc: Prefer the in-app card; fall back to the OS toast. Force the OS toast on Wayland if needed.
general.alertTimeoutDesc: How long the custom card stays visible (5–60s). Hover pauses the timer.
general.alertDndDesc: Suppress completion alerts until the selected window expires
general.alertTestDesc: Show a generic test card. It never uses real project data.
general.alertTestFailed: Could not send the test notification
general.maxSessionWorkersDesc: Parallel worker cap; running sessions are never reclaimed (≥1)
general.sessionWorkerIdleTimeoutDesc: Reclaim idle workers after N minutes; 0 = never by timeout
general.fixedOrderDesc: Keep the project list order stable when opening projects (new ones append to the end); off = most recently used first (default)
general.noRecentProjectsHint: Open a workspace to see it here

runtime.sectionAgentRuntimeDesc: Where the agent runs. In WSL mode it uses the same environment as your terminal inside the distro (login-shell PATH, node, npm).
runtime.modeDesc: Windows native (default), or run inside a WSL distro (Windows only)
runtime.platformUnavailableDesc: WSL mode is only available on Windows hosts
runtime.distroDesc: The agent, its session history and pi configuration live in this distro.
runtime.distroMissingDesc: {{distro}} is not in the WSL distro list, please make sure it is installed
runtime.probeIdle: This distro has not been checked yet
runtime.noCdFlag: wsl.exe lacks --cd; the project directory is entered through the shell
runtime.noDistrosDesc: Install one from PowerShell, then reopen settings.
runtime.envDesc: What the agent actually runs with: taken from your login shell, matching your terminal.
runtime.gitMissingHint: not found (the agent's git operations will fail)

envMode.plain: default environment (shell config could not be read)

runtime.pathExtras: {{count}} PATH entries beyond the default environment:
runtime.fsHint: Tip: projects on a Windows drive are reached through /mnt inside WSL and are slow to read; projects on the distro filesystem (\\wsl.localhost\…) are much faster.
runtime.switchBusy: A conversation is running — switch the runtime once it finishes.
runtime.switchEnvUnavailable: Could not read this distro's environment. Make sure it starts (run wsl -d <distro> in a terminal).

appearance.timelineToolAutoExpandMaxDesc: During an active run, how many recent tool rows auto-expand details; 0 = always collapsed like Cursor (only subtle pulse). Range 0–50, default 0
appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, fonts and density. Previews apply instantly; Save keeps them.
appearance.zoomDesc: Scales this window only. It is not a second theme engine.
appearance.themeDesc: Choose light, dark, or follow system
appearance.iconThemeDesc: Choose the structural icon style used throughout the app; preview updates instantly
appearance.variantLightDesc: Applies only in light mode. Without customization, Pi's default tokens remain untouched.
appearance.variantDarkDesc: Applies only in dark mode and never overwrites the light slot.
appearance.presetDesc: Choose a starting point, then fine-tune it. Manual edits mark the theme as custom.
appearance.defaultSlotHint: Pi's default appearance is active. Choose a preset or import a theme to edit this slot.
appearance.accentDesc: Brand indicator, selection, and focus color.
appearance.surfaceDesc: Base surface used to derive backgrounds, hover states, and borders.
appearance.inkDesc: Primary text anchor used to derive secondary and disabled text.
appearance.fontUiDesc: Enter a locally installed font name only. Empty uses the system stack.
appearance.fontCodeDesc: Enter a locally installed monospace font. Empty uses the Geist Mono fallback stack.
appearance.translucentSidebarDesc: Adjusts only the CSS surface alpha; it does not enable native OS blur.
appearance.contrastDesc: Controls separation between derived surfaces and text levels (0–100).
appearance.contrastWarning: Foreground/background contrast is only {{ratio}}:1, below the 4.5:1 body-text recommendation.
appearance.restoreDefaultDesc: Clear this slot and remove every variable override.
appearance.importDialogDesc: Paste a pi-theme-v1 or codex-theme-v1 string. Preview it before one slot is updated atomically.
appearance.singleVariantHint: A Codex theme string carries one variant, so it fills either the light or dark card. If its variant differs from the card you opened, the payload target wins.
appearance.unsupportedFields: {{count}} field(s) are unsupported in this version and were safely ignored.
appearance.unsupportedHint: Fields without a Pi equivalent, such as codeThemeId and semanticColors.skill, are safely ignored and counted during import.
appearance.shikiHint: Code highlighting (Shiki) does not yet follow custom themes.
appearance.advancedDesc: Free-form CSS is applied after the structured theme for details the token editor cannot cover.
appearance.customCssDesc: Text is written only through the theme draft and existing preview path. Turning it off keeps the CSS.
appearance.safeModeHint: If CSS makes the UI unusable, launch the app with --disable-custom-theme to temporarily skip both structured and free-form custom styles.
appearance.timelineVisibleTurnsDesc: The conversation shows your last this-many messages with their replies; scrolling up reveals the same number again. Default 10.

pi.title: Runtime
pi.description: How the pi agent behaves. Saved to ~/.pi/agent/settings.json and shared with terminal pi; project settings go to the project .pi/settings.json.
pi.loadErrorHint: (Open a workspace first to start the Worker)
pi.fallbackUser: Standalone env unavailable, fell back to built-in
pi.fallbackGlobal: Global version unavailable, fell back to built-in
pi.fallbackWorker: Target SDK failed to load, fell back to built-in
pi.wslModeHint: WSL runtime mode: global version is read from the distro's `npm i -g` install; the active env is fixed to global
pi.wslGlobalNotDetected: pi-coding-agent not found inside the WSL distro; run `npm i -g @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent` in WSL
pi.upgradeSuccess: SDK upgrade complete, switched to standalone env
pi.agentDirDesc: Where global pi configuration lives (settings.json, models.json, skills…).
pi.pathDesc: Whether the pi command is available on PATH.
pi.authDesc: API key or OAuth login status.
pi.providerDesc: Providers with a key or login.
pi.hideThinkingDesc: Collapse the model reasoning in the transcript (terminal pi too).
pi.steeringModeDesc: How messages sent while the agent works are delivered: one at a time or all at once.
pi.followUpModeDesc: How follow-ups queued after the current task are delivered.
pi.transportDesc: Preferred transport when a provider supports several.
pi.httpIdleTimeoutDesc: Give up on a request after this long without data. 0 disables it.
pi.autoCompactionDesc: Summarize earlier conversation when the context is almost full.
pi.compactionReserveDesc: Tokens kept free for the model response, default 16384.
pi.compactionKeepDesc: This many recent tokens stay verbatim, default 20000.
pi.retryEnabledDesc: Resend requests that fail with transient errors.
pi.branchSummaryDesc: Summaries created when jumping between branches in the session tree (read-only).
pi.shellPathDesc: Shell executable for the bash tool; a leading ~ is allowed.
pi.shellPrefixDesc: Prepended to every shell command, e.g. to load environment variables.
pi.npmCommandDesc: Command and arguments used to install pi packages, space-separated.
pi.imageAutoResizeDesc: Resize to at most 2000×2000 before sending, saving tokens and upload time.
pi.showImagesDesc: Terminal pi only: inline images in supported terminals.
pi.blockImagesDesc: Block images from reaching models (attachments and tool results).
pi.defaultProjectTrustDesc: Whether a project .pi configuration (extensions, skills…) is trusted when first opened.
pi.skillCommandsDesc: Register every skill as a /skill:name command.
pi.quietStartupDesc: Terminal pi only: skip the startup header.
pi.treeHint: Session tree: press Esc twice with an empty composer (like /tree in the terminal). Adjust project trust with /trust after opening a project.
pi.sectionConversationDesc: How messages sent while the agent runs are queued, and which notices appear.
pi.cacheNoticesDesc: Notices for significant cache misses, compaction usage and provider recovery.
pi.sectionNetworkDesc: Transport and timeouts for model requests.
pi.wsTimeoutDesc: How long to wait for a WebSocket connection. 0 disables it.
pi.cacheWarmingDesc: Keeps provider prompt caches alive during long tool runs so you do not pay again. Also while idle keeps warming between turns.
pi.needsVersionHint: The active runtime is older: the setting is saved but only takes effect on pi {{version}} or newer.
pi.sectionRetryDesc: Retry automatically when a request fails because of network hiccups or an overloaded service.
pi.retryMaxDesc: How many times one request is retried.
pi.retryDelayDesc: Wait before the first retry; later waits grow exponentially.
pi.retryMaxDelayDesc: Longest wait between retries, so long outages still respond.
pi.sectionCompactionDesc: Near the context limit, pi summarizes older parts of the conversation.
pi.sectionToolShellDesc: Shell and commands used by the bash tool.
pi.sectionImagesDesc: How images sent to models are handled.
pi.sectionTrustDesc: Trust policy for newly opened projects and how skills are invoked.
pi.runtimeVersionsDesc: The pi the desktop app runs agents with. Select a version and click Switch; upgrading installs into the standalone environment and switches to it.
pi.sectionToolsDesc: Tools enabled when a session starts. Takes effect in new sessions or after reload.
pi.builtinToolsDesc: Saved as changes to pi's defaults (read, bash, edit, write), so project settings can still adjust them.
pi.codemodeDesc: Lets the model write JavaScript that calls tools in parallel. Turns on by itself when an MCP server uses codemode exposure.
pi.codemodeModeDesc: Normal: tools declared to the model are only noted in codemode. Only: codemode lists every callable tool.
pi.codemodeBudgetDesc: Estimated tokens the codemode description may spend on tool declarations; the rest are found with searchTools(). 0 lists only namespaces.
pi.toolSearchDesc: Deferred tools stay hidden until the model searches for them, saving tokens on every request.
pi.thinkingBudgetsDesc: Token budget per thinking level for models that take a budget. Blank keeps pi's built-in value.
pi.compactionOverridesDesc: Reserve and recent-token budgets for specific models, e.g. a larger reserve for a 1M-context model. Blank falls back to the values above.

extensions.title: Extensions
extensions.description: Enable or disable pi extensions, sharing settings with terminal pi. The current session reloads extensions after a change.
extensions.missingRuntimeDesc: Cloned locally via git but not listed in settings.packages (terminal may load them another way; desktop will not).
extensions.writePackages: Write to settings.packages and restart Worker
extensions.runtimeNotLoaded: Not loaded in the current session
extensions.noAdapter: No desktop adapter registered (no dedicated desktop UI; tools/commands still load in sessions)
extensions.tuiOnly: Terminal only (TUI decoration, not replicated on desktop)
extensions.workerLoadHint: Cloned locally via git but not listed in settings.packages (terminal may load them another way; desktop will not).
extensions.empty: No extensions detected. Place .ts extension files or directories under .pi/extensions/ to be detected.

adapters.title: Desktop Adapters
adapters.description: Adapters connect pi extensions to the desktop UI: one per extension, defining its panels and settings.
adapters.empty: No desktop adapters registered. Plugins still appear on the Extensions page; to integrate a new plugin, declare an adapter.json in the compat layer.

models.title: Models
models.description: Default model and thinking, plus the providers in {{path}}. Shared with terminal pi.
models.noProvidersHint: Click "Add provider" to pick a template or set up a custom relay.
models.name: Name
models.applyTemplateConfirm:
Overwrite connection config with the {{label}} template?
Keeps current Key and added models.
models.localEmptyHint: Click + in the remote list to add, or add manually
models.enterAtLeastOne: Enter at least one model id
models.manualAddHint: The id must match the API request. Add multiple via line breaks or commas.
models.manualAddPlaceholder: e.g. gpt-4.1-mini or one id per line
models.userProvidersDescription: Editable connections and models from models.json · {{count}}
models.userProvidersEmpty: No user provider yet. Start from a template or configure your own relay.
models.sdkProvidersDescription: Read-only catalog and auth state from the active runtime · {{count}}
models.sdkProvidersEmpty: The active Pi SDK did not return a provider catalog.
models.errInvalidFormat: Only letters, digits, and . - _ : + / % @ (must start with alphanumeric or _)

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.samplingHint: OpenAI-compatible APIs only. Base values apply to every request; a thinking level's values override them. Blank = unset.
advanced.imagesHint: Images are resized once before entering history. Defaults: 2000×2000, 4.5 MiB, quality 80.
advanced.promptCacheHint: Needed for cache warming. Use the conservative end of the provider's range.
advanced.transcriptHint: Enable only if the endpoint accepts system messages after the conversation started. Then capability switches and tool changes are appended instead of rewriting the cached prefix.

voice.accessTokenStoredPlaceholder: Saved ({{preview}}). Leaving this empty keeps it; paste a new token to replace it.
voice.title: Voice Input
voice.description: Choose the transcription service behind the composer mic button. Typing works without it.
voice.apiKeyDesc: Required when serve is started with --api-key
voice.descriptionBuiltin: In-app transcription via your ChatGPT / Codex session (no OpenAI API key, no local codex-asr process).
voice.builtinDesc: Paste an access_token or use ~/.codex/auth.json; requests go to the ChatGPT transcribe API.
voice.codexLoginDesc: Paste a JWT (eyJ…) or import from auth.json. Checks stay on-device. Until you Save at the bottom, Composer may still use the last saved config.
voice.bundledBinaryFallback: Without a bundled binary, PATH codex-asr is used (install separately).
voice.advancedHint: Optional: local codex-asr CLI or your own HTTP serve. Built-in direct API is the default.
voice.unsavedVoiceHint: Voice settings changed but not saved. Composer previews this draft; use Save at the bottom to persist.
voice.cliInstallHint: Only needed when using advanced CLI mode
voice.localApiKeyPlaceholder: Local serve API key (not ChatGPT token)
voice.accessTokenPlaceholder: Paste ChatGPT JWT (eyJ…); saved value overrides auth.json
voice.builtinRuntimeHint: Built-in uses in-app direct calls to ChatGPT transcribe (https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/transcribe). No codex-asr binary or local serve required.

prompts.title: Prompts & Context
prompts.description: Grouped by how they enter the conversation context: project context (AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md), global, and per-turn system. When no global SYSTEM.md exists, opening the "Global" item prefills the built-in text; saving makes it effective. Items marked "per-turn system" are injected into each session.
prompts.empty: No entries found (open a workspace and refresh)
prompts.selectLeftToEdit: Select an item on the left to edit

agentsGlobal.description: Project context from the global agent directory (injected into <project_context>)

systemProject.name: SYSTEM.md (project)
systemProject.description: Replaces the default harness system prompt (overrides global SYSTEM.md)

systemGlobal.descriptionExists: Replaces the default harness system prompt
systemGlobal.descriptionCreate: Not created yet; saving writes ~/.pi/agent/SYSTEM.md and replaces the built-in default

systemDefaultPreview.name: Built-in system (read-only preview)
systemDefaultPreview.description: System prompt assembled for the current session (read-only preview)

appendProject.name: APPEND_SYSTEM.md (project)
appendProject.description: Appended to the end of the system prompt

appendGlobal.name: APPEND_SYSTEM.md (global)
appendGlobal.description: Appended to the end of the system prompt

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Toggles write desktopSkillOverrides. Save reloads related workers.
skills.hint: Skills pi actually loaded. Toggles, display names and icons save together at the bottom; descriptions are written straight back to SKILL.md.
skills.emptyHint: Change the query or filter. If the catalog is empty, open a workspace first.
skills.search: Search name, description, command, or path
skills.incomplete: The session is still starting, so this list is read straight from disk: package skills and name collisions may be missing and editing is disabled. Use Recheck in a moment.
skills.shadowedHint: A higher-priority Skill with the same name is active. Disabling the winner will not promote this one.
skills.readonlyHint: Package and temporary Skills are read-only. Copy one to global or this project before editing it.
skills.aliasHint: Only changes this app's label. The real /skill:name command stays unchanged.
skills.iconHint: Only affects resource lists and entry points in this app.
skills.descriptionHint: Edits only a single-line frontmatter description. Use the full editor for complex YAML.
skills.editComplex: Frontmatter is too complex. Use the full editor.

rightPanels.description: Drag to reorder or hide right-panel tabs; the main window updates after Save.
rightPanels.railIconsDesc: Shows a column of panel icons at the window edge while the right panel is collapsed. Applies at once.

modelDefaults.title: Default model & thinking
modelDefaults.description: Where new sessions start, and which thinking level a session uses when it switches to a model.
modelDefaults.defaultModelDesc: Model for new sessions. Only models with a key or login are listed.
modelDefaults.defaultThinkingDesc: For new sessions, and when switching to a model without a binding.
modelDefaults.cycleScopeDesc: Quick model switching cycles only through these. Comma-separated, wildcards allowed; empty means all.
modelDefaults.bindingsDesc: Switching a session to one of these models applies its level; other models use the default. Shared with terminal pi 0.84+ (modelThinkingLevels).
modelDefaults.bindingsEmpty: No bindings yet. A common setup: Max for deep-reasoning models, Low for fast ones.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.description: Connect Model Context Protocol servers. pi reads ~/.pi/agent/mcp.json and, in trusted projects, .pi/mcp.json. Changes apply to new sessions or after reload.
mcp.importDesc: Paste an mcpServers block from Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code or similar.
mcp.empty: No servers yet. Add one or import a config.
mcp.projectUntrusted: This project is not trusted yet, so its .pi/mcp.json is ignored.
mcp.autoCodemodeDesc: Activate the codemode tool when a server with codemode exposure connects.
mcp.wslUnsupported: MCP management is not available in WSL runtime mode yet.
mcp.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from mcp.json? Stored sign-in is kept.

exposureDesc.codemode: Called from codemode scripts; not declared to the model. Cheapest for large servers.
exposureDesc.deferred: Loaded by tool search when the model needs them, then called directly.
exposureDesc.direct: Declared to the model on every request. Best for a few frequently used tools.

mcp.name: Name
mcp.serverDescriptionPlaceholder: What the server offers, in a sentence

routing.title: Model routing
routing.description: Virtual models that pick a real model for every request. Select router/<id> in the model picker. A classifier (e.g. TypeSafe Jev) can sort each session into a branch. Needs pi 0.99 or later.
routing.saved: Saved. Running sessions use the new routing from their next request.
routing.name: Name
routing.userMessageHint: First message of a session, or every message
routing.classifierHint: Classifier model (provider/model). Leave empty to always use the default.
routing.question: Question for the classifier
routing.fallbackHint: No classifier key, failed classification, and compaction summaries
routing.afterEditHint: Switch once to a cheaper model after the first successful edit/write (one cache miss).
routing.retryOnHint: Retry failed requests on another model instead of the same one.
